newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Boulevard debuts in Manila at 90 centavos.
newsitem.headline: Boulevard debuts in Manila at 90 centavos.

text.p: Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc made its debut on the Philippine Stock Exchange on Monday at a price of 90 centavos, down from its offer price of one peso.
Stock exchange officials said 40,000 shares were traded in the first few minutes of the session.
Boulevard sold 500 million shares, or 50 percent of the company, to the public.
PNB Securities Corp, the underwriter to the issue, said last month with a net asset value (NAV) of 1.76 pesos per share, the offer price of one peso represented a 43 percent discount to the NAV.
Boulevard is one of 13 companies in a consortium that has won the right to develop a 214-hectare tract of land near the central business district of Makati.
